# React App Guidelines

- Reuse existing components before creating new ones.
- Ask before adding or installing any libraries.
- Use existing CSS variables for colors. Follow the current palette; ask before adding colors.
- Give each React component its own directory with a `.tsx` and `.css` file. Import the global stylesheet from the component CSS.
- Prefer CSS classes over inline styles.
- Keep code simple and easy to understand. Ask if requirements are unclear.
